name: Jii-Hoon Jung
source: Gee is an analyst at the company's Risk Department, and Toku's closest friend. Always finding the bright side in every difficult situation, Gee also has a penchant for practical jokes. He is trying to overcome his fears and anxiety of meeting his girlfriend's parents.
